Code, data and visuals for storytellers. This site holds the readings for JOUR472 and JOUR772, which teach how to find, clean, analyze and visualize data for journalism using R and the Tidyverse.

[Start with the introduction](introduction.qmd){.btn .btn-primary .btn-lg role="button"}

## What the course covers

- **[Getting started](start-story.qmd):** reading stories for their data, newsroom math and what counts as data.
- **[Spreadsheets](xl-intro.qmd):** sorting, filtering and formulas in Google Sheets.
- **[Reporting foundations](ethics.qmd):** ethics, public records and GitHub.
- **[R fundamentals](r-basics.qmd):** replication, aggregates, filters, dates and mutating.
- **[Cleaning and combining data](data-cleaning-part-i.qmd):** data smells, janitor, OpenRefine, PDFs, joins and the Census API.
- **[Visualization and maps](visualizing-for-reporting.qmd):** charts for reporting and publication, and geographic analysis.
- **[Advanced topics](textanalysis.qmd):** text analysis, scraping, statistics, AI and writing with data.
